Description:
h3. Objective

Enable users to browse and search products in the shopping app.

h3. Context

The app is a shopping app. It needs product discovery features for users.

h3. Scope

* Browse products
* Search products
* Filter products
* Show stock status

h3. Success criteria

* Users can browse products
* Users can search for products
* Users can filter products
* Users can see stock status for products

Summary: As a user, when I view each product card, I want to see the image, name, and price so that I can identify the product details quickly.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a user, when I view each product card, I want to see the image, name, price, description, and stock status so that I can identify the product details quickly.

h3. Context

This issue is about product cards. The user wants key product details to be visible at a glance.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Each product card shows the image.
* Each product card shows the name.
* Each product card shows the price.
* Each product card shows the description.
* Each product card shows the stock status as In Stock or Out of Stock.

h3. Other information

* This story comes under requirement REQ-B1.

Summary: As a user, when a product is out of stock, I want the Add to Cart button to be disabled so that I cannot add unavailable products.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a user, when a product is out of stock, I want the Add to Cart button to be disabled so that I cannot add unavailable products.

h3. Context

Users should not be able to add out-of-stock products to the cart.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The users should know the stock status always.
* The Add to Cart button is disabled when a product is out of stock.
* Users cannot add unavailable products to the cart.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-B5.

Summary: As a user, when I browse products, I want to filter products by category and by price range and also sort them by name and price so that I can find the products I want more easily.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a user, when I browse products, I want to filter products by category and by price range and also sort them by name and price a-z,low-high,high-low so that I can find the products I want more easily.

h3. Context

Users need to filter products using category and price. Both filters should work together.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Users can filter products by category.
* Users can filter products by price range.
* The price range filter includes both minimum and maximum values.
* Category and price range filters can be used together.
* Users can sort the results of those filters.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirements REQ-B3,ReQ-B4.

Summary: As a user, I can search for products using the product name so that I can find them easily.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a user, when I want to find a product, I want to search for products using the product name so that I can find them easily.

h3. Context

Users need a way to search for products by name.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Search should work using the product name.
* Search should not be case-sensitive.
* If nothing matches, the message "No products found" is shown.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-B2.

Summary: As a user, when I view the product list, I want to see 12 products per page with pagination so that I can review, access, compare, and cart them.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a user, when I view the product list, I want to see 12 products per page with pagination so that I can review, access, compare, and cart them.

h3. Context

The issue is about the product list view. It needs pagination and a fixed number of products per page.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The product list shows 12 products per page.
* Pagination is available on the product list.
* Users can review products from the list.
* Users can access products from the list.
* Users can compare products from the list.
* Users can add products to cart from the list.

h3. Other information

This comes under requirement REQ-B1.
